subject: Deal data certification: LumenEdge - verify amounts, SKUs, and probabilities
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Samantha Ruiz <samantha@lumenedge.com>
Cc: Finance <finance@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Deal data certification: LumenEdge - verify amounts, SKUs, and probabilities

Team / Samantha,

Quick ask ahead of tomorrow's finance commit review: we need clean CRM data for the LumenEdge opportunity (deal ID LUM-2026-Q4-8923). Finance will certify the commit based on the CRM snapshot we hand off at 2pm PT, so please update the fields below in HubSpot by EOD today (or reply here if you can't):

Checklist (what I need updated in the opportunity record):
- Total ARR / contract amount: confirm final number and ensure it matches the attached Opportunity_Snapshot.pdf
- Product / SKU line items: map each SKU to Redwood product names and quantities (example: r-inference-std x3)
- Next steps / owner: short next action and owner (sales owner vs. CS vs. partner)
- Probability: set a percentage reflecting the current commitment level
- Stage and close date: cert stage (Proposal / Commit Review / Contracting) and best estimate close date
- Any procurement constraints / PO date expectations

Samantha, if procurement has a hard PO deadline that affects our close date, please call it out. Marissa / Ben, can one of you take point on normalizing SKU names and validating amounts? Lauren, please confirm the forecast category we should mark (Best Case / Commit).

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8923
Attachment: Opportunity_Snapshot.pdf (snapshot for Finance)

Thanks — I want to avoid last-minute churn and double counting in our forecast. If you update CRM, reply with the fields you changed so Finance can reconcile rapidly.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Samantha Ruiz <samantha@lumenedge.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deal data certification: LumenEdge - verify amounts, SKUs, and probabilities

Karthik — updated the CRM and attaching a mutual action plan with SKU mapping. Highlights:
- Contract amount normalized to $415,000 ARR (entered as 3 line items: r-inf-std x3 @ $125k each minus promotional credit)
- SKU mapping sheet: column A = LumenEdge SKU, column B = Redwood SKU, column C = monthly quantity
- Probability: set to 65% pending procurement confirmation from Samantha
- Stage: moved from "Proposal" to "Commit Review" per our internal gating rules

Attachment: LumenEdge_MutualActionPlan.xlsx

If Finance needs a different break-out format, I can export a CSV in 30 minutes.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | AE Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks for the heads up — procurement here has two clarifications that will affect the CRM fields:
1) LumenEdge requires the contract to be split across three invoice SKUs (InfraCore, EdgeOps, and SupportTier). Can you reflect that split in the line items? We can provide the internal SKU mapping if needed.
2) Procurement needs a PO by 20 Oct to adhere to our Q4 budget cycle. If Redwood requires signatures or a revised SOW to invoice, we need that by Oct 19.

I've cc'd our procurement lead in a separate mail (not on this thread) — for now, the two asks mean probability should stay at 60% until we get a PO commitment. If Marissa's spreadsheet includes the SKU mapping, that should be fine.

Regards,
Samantha Ruiz
Head of IT Procurement, LumenEdge
samantha@lumenedge.com

- Amount: $415,000 ARR (matched to legal billing schedule)
- SKU lines: InfraCore / EdgeOps / SupportTier entered per Samantha's ask (see attachments)
- Stage: Commit Review -> Contracting (Finance flagged as ready for approval)

- Close date: set to 2026-10-28 (reflects PO timing + internal signature SLAs)

Karthik — I left a short note in HubSpot under "Forecast notes" with the procurement deadline and the contact at LumenEdge. Finance will pull from this snapshot at 2pm PT for the commit call.

—Ben
